stemMd: Starting from 50, a sequence alternately subtracts 6 and adds 2, beginning with subtraction. What is the value after six operations?
explanationMd: Each pair of operations changes the value by −6 + 2 = −4. Six operations contain three pairs, for a total change of −12. The final value is 50 − 12 = 38.

distractorRationale.d: This applies only two subtract-add cycles.
distractorRationale.a: This subtracts six at every operation and ignores additions.
distractorRationale.e: This stops after the first operation.
distractorRationale.b: This subtracts four at every operation instead of every pair.
